simple.meaning: דָּרוֹם (dârôwm) is a Hebrew object word meaning “the south ; poet. the south wind.” BibleIQ follows the concrete thing through the verses where it appears.
simple.biblicalBackground: The occurrence trail begins at Deuteronomy 33:23. The surrounding context includes family line, land, Israel.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to דָּרוֹם (H1864) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: Concrete words often carry patterns through Scripture because objects, animals, offerings, and created things are used repeatedly in worship, judgment, covenant, and narrative.

timeline.evidenceText: The wind goes toward the south, and turns around to the north. It turns around continually as it goes, and the wind returns again to its courses.
If the clouds are full of rain, they empty themselves on the earth;
“Son of man, set your face toward Jerusalem, and preach toward the sanctuaries, and prophesy against the land of Israel.
He led me toward the south; and behold, there was a gate toward the south. He measured its posts and its arches according to these measurements.
He led me toward the south; and behold, there was a gate toward the south. He measured its posts and its arches according to these measurements.
There was a gate to the inner court toward the south. He measured one hundred cubits from gate to gate toward the south.
There was a gate to the inner court toward the south. He measured one hundred cubits from gate to gate toward the south.
Then he brought me to the inner court by the south gate. He measured the south gate according to these measurements;
Then he brought me to the inner court by the south gate. He measured the south gate according to these measurements;
Outside of the inner gate were rooms for the singers in the inner court, which was at the side of the north gate. They faced toward the south. One at the side of the east gate faced toward the north.
He said to me, “This room, which faces toward the south, is for the priests, the keepers of the duty of the house.
The doors of the side rooms were toward an open area that was left, one door toward the north, and another door toward the south. The width of the open area was five cubits all around.
According to the doors of the rooms that were toward the south was a door at the head of the way, even the way directly before the wall toward the east, as one enters into them.

Then he said to me, “The north rooms and the south rooms, which are before the separate place, are the holy rooms, where the priests who are near to Yahweh shall eat the most holy things. There they shall lay the most holy things, with the meal offering, the sin offering, and the trespass offering; for the place is holy.
He measured on the south side five hundred reeds with the measuring reed.

definitions.short: the south ; poet. the south wind
definitions.full: H1864. darom דָּרוֺם noun masculine south (in poetry & late) (on formation compare Ol § 216 a Sta § 295 ) — דָּרוֺם Job 37:17 14 t. + Ezek 40:27 b; 40:28 b (strike out ᵑ6 Co in 40:27 b 40:27 b; AB ᵑ9 Co in Ezekiel 27b 40:28 b — south , 42:18 (over against יָם צָפוֺן, קָדִים, ); 12 t. more in Ezekiel (of which Co strike out 2, compare above) 21:2 (= תֵּימָנָה and נֶגֶב ); הַדּ ׳דֶּרֶךְ toward south 40:24 (twice in verse); 40:27 , read also הַדּ ׳דֶּרֶךְ 42:10 for ᵐ5 ׳ד הַקָּדִים Ke Co; הַדּ ׳שַׁעַר south gate 40:[27]; 40:28 compare Co above, 40:44 (opposed to צפון ; also קדים ), 40:45 (opposed to צפון ) 42:12 = ׳לַדָּ 41:11 (opposed to צפון ), הד ׳לִשְׁכוֺת 42:13 (opposed to צפון ). Elsewhere only Deut 33:23 (|| יַם ), Job 37:17 ; Eccl 1:6 ; 11:3 (both opposed to צפון ).
